desc: JOB TITLE: Analyst, Major League Strategy & Analytics DEPARTMENT: Baseball Strategy FLSA STATUS: Part-time/Seasonal LOCATION: Baltimore, MD REPORTS TO: Assistant General Manager JOB SUMMARY: The Major League Strategy & Analytics Analyst connects Baseball Operations and Research & Development with the Major League coaching staff, using data, models, and scouting information to deliver clear recommendations that coaches and players can deploy. This position reports to the Assistant General Manager and works closely with the Major League Manager and coaching staff, Major League Advance Scouting, Research & Development, Player Development, Professional Scouting, and Major League players.     PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Primary duties include, but are not limited to, the following : Prepare opponent breakdowns in advance of each series across all pillars of the game, including offense, defense, baserunning, and pitching. Convert analytical processes and models into concise, actionable takeaways that players and coaching staff can use for decision-making and game preparation. Act as the coaching staff’s go-to analytical resource in the clubhouse. Serve as a liaison between the Major League staff and the Baseball Analytics department, ensuring coaching staff questions regarding advanced information are answered in a timely and accurate manner. Analyze and provide feedback to the Analytics department on which analytical tools have the highest impact among staff and players and which tools can be improved upon. Use SQL and R/Python daily to filter through large sets of information in an organized way. Travel with the club and willingness to work non-traditional hours (nights, weekends, holidays) as dictated by Orioles and MLB schedule.   WORK LOCATION & TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: Position is based primarily in Baltimore, with travel alongside the Major League team during Spring Training and the regular season.   QUALIFICATIONS Completion of Bachelor’s degree, with a preference but not limited to Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or equivalent. Experience with creating and completing advance materials for a Major League club. Proficiency with SQL, R/Python, and familiarity with Statcast and Hawk-Eye data. Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to collaborate with players and staff members of various backgrounds and responsibilities, and present advanced information in a clear and actionable way. Familiarity with MLB’s in-game and transaction rules.   *Applicants with various and/or non-traditional educational background and experience will be considered and are encouraged to apply   The anticipated base salary for this role is $60,000 - $80,000 annually depending on experience.
